mapper.select: SELECT crt.user_id as userId, crt.book_id as bookId, bks.book_title as bookTitle, crt.book_count as bookCount, bks.book_price as bookPrice FROM cart as crt JOIN books as bks ON crt.book_id = bks.book_id WHERE crt.user_id = #{userID} ORDER BY crt.user_id asc, crt.book_id asc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_details ( user_id, order_number, order_branch_number, book_id, order_price, book_count, order_date ) VALUES ( #{userID}, #{orderNumber}, #{branchNumber}, #{book.bookId}, #{book.totalPrice}, #{book.bookCount}, CURRENT_DATE )
